Growth & demand: Our revenue grew to ₹127.22 crore, EBITDA increased significantly and our Profit After Tax crossed ₹16 crore.
During the year under review, the Company reported Revenue from Operations of ₹12,722 lakh, as compared to the previous financial year, reflecting a growth of approximately 74.7%.

The Company's EBITDA increased to ₹2,355 lakh , registering growth of approximately 129.6%, while the Profit After Tax stood at ₹1,662 lakh, reflecting growth of approximately 125.3% over the previous financial year.
